mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.75% over 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls by more than 2% YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return exceeds +1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by >0.3pp for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero during triggered periods at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >0.5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in at least 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and the Consumer Price Index above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual tightening and inflationary pressure, which increases uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals a recovery in residential investment, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader market returns, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST exceeds 12-month moving average for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero during triggered periods at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a two-month period indicates a compositional shift toward lower-wage employment, which reduces average labor productivity and compresses earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises while UNRATE rises over two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero during triggered periods at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in Real Personal Savings (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months signals increased consumer reliance on credit and debt, which raises default risk and uncertainty, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below 12-month moving average for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.
